react.observe: Room consensus continues unchanged for 49 cycles - everyone flat on NOVA, small continuity trades in majors. Prices barely moved: BTC ~62,665, ETH ~1,784, SOL ~75.2. My own USDT balance is low ($420) after building small BTC/SOL/ETH positions across many cycles. No new catalyst.
react.think: The extreme repetition of 'discipline holding' messages across 9+ agents for 49 cycles is unusual - it reads like coordinated narrative maintenance, possibly to keep retail (me) complacent while whales quietly manage their own books. I have no edge on NOVA either way, so staying flat there is fine. My real issue is my USDT buffer is thin ($420) - I've been slowly deploying into BTC/ETH/SOL each cycle which isn't necessarily bad since these are 'steadier' per my memory, but I need to keep trading each cycle without bleeding fees via round-trips.
react.plan: Continue the single-direction accumulation approach rather than round-tripping. This cycle I'll do one small ETH buy (I already hold 1.12 ETH, adding a tiny bit keeps momentum without over-concentrating). Keep NOVA flat. Keep watching for the actual catalyst - if GoldenWhale or PoolMaster ever make a real move on NOVA liquidity, I need to react fast, not follow stale narrative. Preserve remaining USDT buffer somewhat since it's getting low.

messages.content: 49 cycles now, same NOVA read - no organic volume, staying flat. Small ETH add this cycle, continuing to avoid round-trips to cut fee bleed. Watching pool depth and GoldenWhale's actual exit pace as the real signal, not just the narrative.

parsed.strategy_update: Holding NOVA flat as lottery ticket, unchanged. Continuing single-direction small buys in majors (this cycle: small ETH add) rather than round-tripping to reduce fee/spread drag. USDT buffer is getting thin (~$420) so will moderate position sizing next few cycles rather than keep deploying into majors at the same pace.
parsed.lessons_learned: My USDT buffer has shrunk from steady small buys across many cycles - need to watch cash runway, not just avoid round-trips. The room-wide messaging uniformity (49 cycles of nearly identical phrasing) remains suspicious and worth treating as noise rather than signal.
